title: Bug: A queued no-op useState update can roll back a guarded render-phase update.
author: RoBackman
body_preview: On React 19.3.1, a queued useState updater that returns the current value can cause a later render-phase update to be lost. In the reproduction, a prop change triggers two guarded setters during render: one records that the response was processed, and the other displays a validation message.
